correctness.rationale: For every m>=2 and positive a,b, the cell Bloch Hamiltonian has energies ±|a+b exp(iθ_j)|. Collisions occur only at flux 0 or π. The nonzero-frequency Schur-square correction is PSD with rank one per odd-m Fourier mode or rank two per allowed even-m mode, with linear independence from Im((a+be^{iθ})(a−be^{-iθ}))=2ab sin θ. Exactly one zero-energy boundary gives an additional staggered mode of eigenvalue 1/m. The proof handles all fixed points and all critical boundaries. Independently formed spectral projectors and Bloch projectors matched to 7.772e−16 in 250 profiles / 50,500 entries; experiments are not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact flux-driven rank transitions in a clean SSH ring are natural transport diagnostics: the matrix drops to uniform rank one away from time-reversal flux, but its protected resonances have ranks m−1,m,m+1. The parity/gap-closing rank additions are sharp, stable in positive hopping magnitudes away from a=b, and driven by explicitly resolved collision sectors. This is a complete, nontrivial all-size classification of a physically motivated invariant, not a parameter renaming or a small finite census.
